description: This file defines a class 'Length' within the OpenCart system's cart library, which manages measurement units, conversions, and formatting related to item lengths in the shopping cart system.

classes.name: Length
classes.description: Provides methods to handle length units, conversions between different measurement systems, and formatting length measurements for display.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Length class, loads length measurement data from the database based on the current language.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts a length value from one unit to another based on stored unit data.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats a length value into a string with appropriate units and number formatting.

methods.name: getUnit
methods.description: Retrieves the measurement unit string for a given length class ID.
